top_signals.title: US Wants India’s Reliance to Refine More Venezuelan Oil
top_signals.summary: The US is looking to persuade India’s Reliance Industries to refine more Venezuelan crude as Washington seeks to bring additional supplies to a market rattled by the Iran conflict. Bloomberg's Sudhi Ranjan Sen has more from US Secretary of State Marco Rubio's visit to India. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UK Debt Tops £3 Trillion as Borrowing Soars Ahead of Budget
top_signals.summary: Britain’s national debt topped £3 trillion ($4 trillion) for the first time as the government borrowed more than forecast in the first half of the year, according to official figures that underline the challenge Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey faces at his inaugural budget next week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Domino’s Pizza loses pace after World Cup rush
top_signals.summary: Sales growth at Domino’s Pizza has slowed in recent months, as the takeaway giant struggled to extend the boost in takings it enjoyed during the World Cup this summer. top_signals.title: Mozilla, Google, Apple block compromised eMudhra CA certificates
top_signals.summary: Certificate authority eMudhra revoked eight compromised intermediate certificates after researchers found their private keys were so weak that anyone could recover them almost instantly and use them to forge trusted certificates for legitimate websites. [...]
